online_etipos.source: var datumUzavierkyExtraVyplata = "2026-11-23 17:45:00"; herny plan cl. 14 (internetova heren 17:45)

shop_terminal.source: herny plan cl. 14 table (predajne miesta, pondelok, EXTRA VYPLATA 18:00)

closing_time_23_11.cancellation: a bet can be cancelled within 15 min of placing it; bets placed <15 min before closing only until closing (herny plan cl. 9)

jackpots.ExtraVyplataJackpot: 480 000 EUR (fixed 6+1 prize, not a rolling jackpot; label 'Maximalna mozna vyhra', JackpotGarant)
jackpots.ExtraVyplata_rollover: none: unwon tier money goes to the guarantee fund (garancny fond)
jackpots.VsetkoAleboNicJackpot: 100 000 EUR (fixed, shared between all 11-hit and 0-hit winners)
jackpots.premium_draw: GetForDate Premium=null for EV 19.11 and VAN 22.11; latest EV premium decision on herne-plany page is still October 2026; general November decision (13.11) already past

draw_dates_confirmed.method: GetZrebovania lists only past draws (Nov 2026 list ends at 2026-11-19 for EV and 2026-11-22 for VAN; Dec 2026 returns []); GetForDate 2026-11-23 returns empty record. Future draw confirmed by page vars datumZrebovania*=2026-11-23 18:00:00 and herny plan schedule.

next_draws.basis: herny plan cl. 14 table (EV Mon+Thu, Thu draws since 23.04.2026 per cl. 36; VAN daily) + past pattern; not yet listed by API

stake.extra_vyplata: 1,50 EUR per bet/field, same online (ExtraVyplataMinimalnaVyskaStavky = 1,50 EUR); max 8 bets per ticket; subscription up to 12 periods
stake.vsetko_alebo_nic: 1,50 EUR per bet, same online (VsetkoAleboNicMinimalnaVyskaStavky = 1,50 EUR); max 10 bets per ticket; no system bets; subscription up to 12 periods

rules_notes.source: Herny plan ciselnych loterii 2026, effective 18.03.2026, text version on tipos.sk (art. 29 EV, art. 34 VAN, art. 14 closing times)

extra_vyplata.matrix: player picks 6 of 1..27 AND 1 extra (powerball) number of 1..7 himself (6/27 + 1/7); draw: 6 from drum 1, 1 from drum 2
extra_vyplata.prize_pool: 57,90 % of stakes; only highest prize per field

tiers.1 (6+1): fixed 480 000 EUR, paid in monthly instalments over 10 years (=4 000 EUR/month); lump sum ONLY if 7+ tier-1 winners; 2 winners -> 480 000/2 each; 3+ winners -> 720 000 (max quota)/n
tiers.2 (6+0): fixed 30 000 EUR lump sum; 2+ winners share 30 000

extra_vyplata.rounding: tier 3-8 prizes rounded down to 0,10 EUR; leftovers + unwon tiers -> guarantee fund (no rollover)
extra_vyplata.schedule_text_note: art. 29 still says '1 period per week, usually Monday', but art. 14 table and art. 36 (first Thursday draw 23.04.2026) give Mon+Thu; API confirms Mon+Thu

vsetko_alebo_nic.top_sharing: if more than one 11-hit, more than one 0-hit, or both 11-hit and 0-hit occur, each gets 100 000 / (total count), rounded down to 0,10 EUR
vsetko_alebo_nic.tiers_2_7: fixed regardless of number of winners

rules_notes.differences_vs_FINDINGS: none material; added: no lump-sum option for a single EV 6+1 winner, 2-winner/3+-winner split rule, EV 6+0 split rule, shop terminal closes 18:00 vs online 17:45 vs SMS 17:30

sources: https://www.tipos.sk/ and https://www.tipos.sk/extra-vyplata, /vsetko-alebo-nic (404 pages with identical JS vars)
